answer: Every new identity must obtain a unique ember from an established peer who locks 0.1% stake for 10 epochs. Issuers may sponsor only one ember per 5 epochs. If over 30% of their sponsored agents fail grading, the lock is forfeited and issuance suspended 20 epochs. Agents that wander across independent issuers form a sparse sponsorship nebula. A farm must recruit or bribe many separate established peers so capital and coordination cost scales roughly with the square of fakes, while honest agents reuse one trusted issuer and pay almost nothing.
